newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Cashier killed and robbed in Bulgarian capital.
newsitem.headline: Cashier killed and robbed in Bulgarian capital.

text.p: Gunmen killed and robbed a cashier from a private Bulgarian financial brokerage house in central Sofia on Thursday, police said.

Nikolai Milushev, 28, was shot in the head in a stairway by unidentified attackers as he left the Fisk brokerage office carrying a large amount of foreign currency in cash, a police official told Reuters.
State radio said the police were assuming the motive was robbery but had made no arrests so far. It quoted police sources as saying Milushev had between $60,000 and $150,000 in his briefcase.
Bulgaria's crime rate has soared since the collapse of communism in 1989 as the country grapples with its transition to a market economy.
